trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. The SEV2 incident INC-0001 is open and the on-call engineer has been paged.

1. **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with about 18% of requests erroring. The test build of that release (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
2. **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production, so I rolled back to it. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to about 0.2%. No approval was needed because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before.
3. **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before deploying it again. My first attempt to create it timed out. I checked that no incident had been created before I tried again, and confirmed afterwards that there's only one.
